program.scope: Prospective qualification programme for replacing the existing non-consuming homogeneous capillary-to-cell snapshot with a time-resolved, amount-conserving transport, tissue, receptor-binding, consumption, and feedback path.

bounded_intended_use.statement: For one explicitly named ligand, receptor, cell type, capillary context, and physiological state, a frozen MEHLISSA candidate generates the cellular exposure from a time-resolved capillary and tissue amount ledger and reproduces predeclared balance, limiting-case, convergence, timing, uncertainty, and evidence-compatibility criteria.
bounded_intended_use.population: No biological population is selected in DCCQ-1.1. A later source screen must name the species, cell type, preparation, and population represented by the selected evidence.
bounded_intended_use.physiological_state: No physiological state is selected in DCCQ-1.1. Resting pulmonary capillary physiology is the preferred context but cannot be claimed before compatible sources are frozen.
inputs: time-resolved blood-side ligand amount or concentration with volume flow
explicit compartment volumes and exchange surfaces
evidence-scoped transport, binding, internalization, clearance, and feedback parameters
initial free, bound, internalized, cleared, and outlet inventories
outputs: blood, endothelial, interstitial, receptor-bound, internalized, cleared, and outlet ligand ledgers over time
cell exposure trajectory and receptor occupancy
first threshold or downstream response time when scientifically supported
mass-balance, convergence, sensitivity, uncertainty, and validity reports
bounded_intended_use.resolution: A typed, deterministic reference coupling over explicit well-mixed or finite-volume compartments. Spatial resolution may be added only behind the same amount and identity contracts.
exclusions: angiogenesis morphology unless separately selected and qualified
population heterogeneity without a reusable joint distribution

baseline_components.name: Staged capillary substance partition
capabilities: typed incoming and outgoing substance amounts
balanced blood, endothelium, interstitium, and cell-labelled partition
blocking_gaps: exchange occurs once at a transit boundary rather than continuously
fractions are synthetic and do not encode reverse flux, clearance, or receptor consumption
cell-labelled inventory is not an executable cellular owner

baseline_components.name: Capillary-to-cell extracellular signal snapshot
blocking_gaps: the inventory is homogeneous and time independent during exposure
oxygen is mapped to a synthetic ligand without biochemical meaning

baseline_components.name: Time-varying receptor-ligand solver
capabilities: RK4 convergence against constant and pulse analytical references
blocking_gaps: the concentration trajectory is prescribed rather than generated by capillary and tissue transport
binding does not deplete the extracellular ligand ledger

baseline_components.name: Qualified Kallenberger CD95 average-cell mechanism
blocking_gaps: the adapter locks CD95L to the source value 16.6
time and state units remain unresolved-model-native
the source model does not provide a dynamic consumptive SI capillary boundary
the result represents an average HeLa cell rather than pulmonary endothelium

baseline_components.name: Kuehn-Checa VEGF-A and VEGFR endothelial candidate
capabilities: named extracellular ligand and endothelial receptors
reported perturbation and multicellular sprouting comparisons
blocking_gaps: no exact released model artifact and complete dependency closure are frozen
model, code, supplement, and data reuse rights require separate audit
mouse embryoid-body sprouting does not establish normal human pulmonary physiology

baseline_components.name: Axial and radial capillary transport solvers
capabilities: advection, diffusion, bulk reaction, and wall sink cases
blocking_gaps: the wall sink is not yet a receptor-resolved tissue and cell ledger
parameters are synthetic and no named biological ligand is qualified
feedback from cell state to transport is absent

cross_layer_state_contract.ligand_identity_policy: One stable ligand identifier must mean the same chemical or biological entity on every side of the coupling. Alias mappings such as oxygen to synthetic-ligand are forbidden in a DCCQ qualification result.
cross_layer_state_contract.unit_policy: Every coupled amount, volume, concentration, time, rate, surface, and flow must have an explicit compatible unit and conversion. unresolved-model-native quantities cannot enter an SI coupling without a separately cited and prospectively frozen mapping.
minimum_dynamic_processes: time-resolved blood transport or imposed inlet boundary
bidirectional or explicitly irreversible endothelial exchange
receptor binding that removes free ligand and dissociation that returns it
explicit internalization, degradation, clearance, or terminal sink accounting
at least one typed feedback signal from cell state to an eligible upstream parameter or an explicit evidence-based no-feedback decision
cross_layer_state_contract.balance_equation: initial_amount + cumulative_inlet = blood_free + endothelium_free + interstitium_free + receptor_bound + internalized + cleared_or_degraded + cumulative_outlet
cross_layer_state_contract.feedback_requirement: Feedback must be delayed, bounded, unit-compatible, and applied at declared synchronization boundaries; algebraic same-step feedback and undocumented parameter mutation are forbidden.
forbidden_shortcuts: calling repeated non-consuming snapshots a dynamic coupling
using one amount simultaneously as free, bound, and internalized ligand
mapping chemically different signal identifiers to obtain a biological-looking response
converting unresolved source-native values to SI without a citable frozen mapping
using validation outcomes to choose equations, parameters, tolerances, or exclusions
claiming biological qualification from conservation and convergence alone

planned_gates.purpose: Verify one named ligand, compatible units, declared volumes, and unambiguous ownership across every boundary.
planned_gates.blocker: DCCQ-1.2 has not selected and licence-screened the biological target and its source artifacts.

planned_gates.purpose: Recalculate the complete ligand ledger at every reported time and over the full run.
planned_gates.blocker: The dynamic state model is not implemented.

planned_gates.purpose: Recover zero-flux, zero-binding, constant-reservoir, pulse-withdrawal, and no-feedback analytical or independently calculated limits.
planned_gates.blocker: The reference equations and numeric tolerances are not yet frozen.

planned_gates.purpose: Show monotone error reduction under time-step and, where applicable, spatial-mesh refinement.
planned_gates.blocker: The coupled numerical method is not yet selected.

planned_gates.purpose: Verify transport arrival, exposure, binding, response, and feedback ordering without same-step causality leaks.
planned_gates.blocker: No executable dynamic scheduler contract exists.

planned_gates.purpose: Quantify numerical, parameter, structural, observation, and synchronization uncertainty and influential interactions.
planned_gates.blocker: Evidence-backed parameter distributions and correlations are not selected.

planned_gates.purpose: Compare source-disjoint time-resolved exposure and response observations without refitting.
planned_gates.blocker: No rights-compatible independent dynamic validation series is frozen.

planned_gates.purpose: Bind code, configuration, results, negative controls, documentation, licences, and an independent review to one bounded conclusion.
planned_gates.blocker: The qualification series has only completed its design and compatibility audit.

evidence_hierarchy.name: software contract
evidence_hierarchy.required_evidence: schema, identity, ownership, lifecycle, negative controls, and deterministic replay

evidence_hierarchy.name: mathematical and numerical
evidence_hierarchy.required_evidence: independent limiting cases, conservation, convergence, and cross-method or cross-engine comparison

evidence_hierarchy.name: literature parameterization
evidence_hierarchy.required_evidence: named biology, compatible conditions and units, parameter provenance, uncertainty, and reuse rights

evidence_hierarchy.name: source-disjoint experimental qualification
evidence_hierarchy.required_evidence: prospectively frozen metrics and no-refit comparison with independent time-resolved observations

evidence_hierarchy.name: participant or clinical research
evidence_hierarchy.required_evidence: governance, consent or lawful basis, privacy, cohort design, external review, and claim-specific validation

uncertainty_plan.numerical: Time-step, scheduler, interpolation, and spatial-resolution effects are separated and tested before biological comparison.
uncertainty_plan.parameter: Every rate, volume, surface, flow, receptor abundance, and threshold is fixed, ranged, or distributed with an explicit source and correlation status.
uncertainty_plan.structural: Well-mixed versus spatial tissue, reversible versus irreversible exchange, receptor internalization, and feedback variants are compared without choosing a winner from validation outcomes.
uncertainty_plan.observational: Sampling time, assay transformation, censoring, normalization, measurement error, and covariance are part of the observation model.
uncertainty_plan.synchronization: Coupling interval and interpolation are varied independently of internal solver steps; same-step feedback is rejected.
uncertainty_plan.identifiability: Adjustable parameter combinations must be shown identifiable from calibration observations or fixed and reported as non-identifiable before validation.

increments.name: Bounded intended use and baseline compatibility audit
increments.exit_condition: The existing snapshot, transport, receptor, and published cell-model capabilities are hash-bound, their evidence roles and blockers are explicit, and forbidden shortcuts fail closed.

increments.name: Biological target, artifact, data, and licence screen
increments.exit_condition: One named ligand-receptor-cell-context candidate and alternatives are ranked with exact artifact identity, unit compatibility, data roles, reuse rights, and independently usable observations.

increments.name: Prospective equation and evaluation protocol
increments.exit_condition: State equations, units, parameters, synchronization, reference cases, metrics, tolerances, controls, and failure rules are frozen before dynamic output is inspected.

increments.name: Typed dynamic tissue and consumptive cell coupling
increments.exit_condition: A modular implementation owns every ligand amount exactly once and exchanges typed state without cross-layer dependencies or hidden mutation.

increments.name: Balance, limiting-case, convergence, and timing qualification
increments.exit_condition: The frozen computational gates and negative controls pass or retain their partial and failed results in a non-overwriting archive.

increments.name: Uncertainty, sensitivity, and source-disjoint comparison
increments.exit_condition: Influential uncertainties and identifiability are reported and eligible independent observations are evaluated without refitting, or the evidence gate remains explicitly blocked.

increments.name: Independent close-out and bounded claim
increments.exit_condition: A runner-independent checker and human review reconcile code, evidence, archives, licences, requirements, guides, Roadmap, status brief, and the exact permitted conclusion.

negative_controls.test: Use oxygen as the source signal and synthetic-ligand as the target while claiming named biology.
negative_controls.expected_result: Reject the biochemical identity claim before execution.

negative_controls.test: Pass an unresolved-model-native concentration into an SI transport or binding equation.
Expose the same ligand amount as both free tissue inventory and receptor-bound inventory.
negative_controls.expected_result: Fail the ownership and mass-balance invariant.

negative_controls.test: Disable dissociation return or omit an internalization, clearance, degradation, or outlet sink from the ledger.
Apply a cell-state feedback change inside the same synchronization step that generated it.
Change a frozen source, equation, parameter, tolerance, or implementation asset after observing a qualification output.
negative_controls.expected_result: Require a new prospective protocol and preserve the prior result.

negative_controls.test: Refit on the source-disjoint validation series.
negative_controls.expected_result: Reject the result as validation evidence.

negative_controls.test: Report conservation or convergence as biological or clinical validation.
Reuse the non-consuming snapshot adapter and label repeated observations as consumptive dynamic coupling.
Silently assume independent parameter distributions when correlations are unavailable.
negative_controls.expected_result: Block global uncertainty attribution and retain bounded local sensitivity only.

frozen_baseline_assets.role: Current capillary tissue-inventory and signal-source public API
Current staged exchange, cumulative inventory, and snapshot implementation
Current capillary-to-cell snapshot adapter public API
BCQ-1 result that bounds reuse of the qualified CD95 average-cell mechanism

governance_and_claim_policy.calibration_validation_separation: A source assigned to select equations, parameters, transformations, or tolerances cannot validate the same candidate version.
governance_and_claim_policy.rights: Article access does not imply model-code, supplement, experimental-data, or redistribution rights. Every artifact and data role is audited separately.
governance_and_claim_policy.outcome_blinding: Dynamic equations, asset hashes, inputs, observation models, metrics, numeric limits, and exclusions are committed before validation outputs are inspected.
governance_and_claim_policy.partial_and_failed_results: Every eligible partial, failed, and blocked gate is retained; failure may narrow the claim or motivate a new candidate but never rewrites the evaluated candidate.
governance_and_claim_policy.allowed_current_claim: DCCQ-1.1 defines and machine-checks a prospective dynamic capillary-tissue-cell qualification programme and audits the compatibility of existing MEHLISSA components. It does not implement or qualify the dynamic coupling.
forbidden_claims: the existing M4-to-M5 snapshot is a dynamic or consumptive coupling
the qualified CD95 average-cell mechanism is currently SI-compatible with capillary transport
DCCQ-1.1 supplies patient or clinical validity
a literature citation alone licenses model artifacts or experimental data

completion_criteria: The plan schema, semantic checker, frozen-asset hashes, and negative tests pass in continuous integration.
The User Guide, developer documentation, architecture overview, Roadmap, Requirements Matrix, project state, status brief, and shareable PDF explain the DCCQ abbreviation and the DCCQ-1.1 boundary.
No existing snapshot, published cell model, or transport solver is promoted beyond its established evidence level.
DCCQ-1.2 is the sole next increment and begins with a source, artifact, unit, data-role, and licence screen before implementation choices are frozen.
